description.value: Tofino Motel Harborview is a small, water-view motel in Tofino managed under Island Village Properties, which also offers waterfront condos, cabins, and apartments for short or long-term stays. It sits within walking distance of seafood restaurants, cafes, and boat tour operators in one of Vancouver Island's most celebrated coastal destinations. Cyclists exploring the area have ready access to surfing, hiking, and biking on the beaches of Tofino.
